title: Chapter 766 Everyone'S Harvest; The World Annihilating Golden Lotus!
content:
Chapter 766 Everyone'S Harvest; The World Annihilating Golden Lotus!

Chapter 766 Everyone's Harvest; The World Annihilating Golden Lotus!

The man in the long robe didn't care about Lin Fan at all.

After all, although time laws were rare.

However, it wasn't like there weren't any.

However, as he continued to advance, a hint of surprise gradually appeared on the long-robed man's originally calm face.

Because he realized that the young man behind him had been following him all along.

Moreover, his expression was extremely relaxed.

He looked like he was taking a walk in the forest.

One had to know…

Now, they were already 10,000 meters away from the Great Dao of Time!

Such talent was simply…Rare!

The long-robed man was surprised as he continued to move forward.

When he reached 20,000 meters, he found that the young man behind him was still the same.

Finally, he couldn't help but stop and say,""Dao Youhao."

In fact, when the long robed man noticed Lin Fan.

Lin Fan was also paying attention to him.

At this moment, when he heard the other party's greeting, he also said,"Dao Youhao."

"My name is Tao Qian. May I know who you are?" The long-robed man smiled."

Tao Qian!

He was the one who left the door on Earth.

"Lin Fan." Lin Fan said.

Tao Qian said," It's been a long time since I've met someone who walked so far in the Dao of Time. Lin Fan, shall we go together?" And discuss it?"

"Alright." Lin Fan said.

Thus, the two of them chatted as they walked.

The two of them had a deep understanding of the Great Path of Time and had many common topics.

The two of them talked about their understanding of time, their methods, and their insights.

As they chatted, the two of them made progress in the passage of time.

Before they knew it, they had arrived at the 300,000-meter mark.

At this moment, Lin Fan and Tao Qian both felt the pressure. Their bodies were trembling slightly.

They did not force their way forward. Instead, they looked at each other and smiled.

"Fellow Daoist, see you next time!"

As soon as he finished speaking, the two of them turned into streams of light and disappeared.

Then, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan's mind.

[Ding! [Tao Qian has a favorable impression of you. Current favorable impression rating: 4 stars.]]

When Lin Fan heard this, he muttered," To think that there would be someone who could walk so far on the path of the Time Laws.""

Whether it was the mythical stories of his childhood or the fact that the system had yet to produce a gemstone that could allow the temporal law to reach a high level, all of them showed how powerful and special the temporal law was.

And Tao Qian was able to go so far…It was enough to prove that he was extraordinary.

Lin Fan said," I just met a random person and he could go so far. I have to work harder.""

And so, Lin Fan entered a deeper state of cultivation.

....

Deep in the universe.

Tao Qian slowly opened his eyes."

His tone was filled with joy.

It was the feeling of meeting a confidant.

"I've gained a lot this time. I'll digest it first. Next time, I'll discuss it properly."

....

On the other hand, the major factions were devouring the smaller factions, and the speed at which they occupied territory was increasing.

Gradually, friction appeared between the major factions and a battle erupted.

Sea World, Demon World, Fire God Palace...

In just a hundred years, countless planets had turned into dust and countless members of factions had become corpses.

It was unknown when it started, but the major factions started to fight for real.

The King and Emperor levels all entered the battlefield. Later on, the Holy Lord level also entered the battlefield.

Planets exploded, star fields were destroyed, and even a universe was reduced to nothingness.

The people were plunged into misery and misery.

Especially the Buddha Realm.

Yes, it was!

Especially the Buddha Realm.

Even though the Bodhi Fruit possessed a powerful defensive pearl.

Even though the Buddha Realm had two Holy Lords, Pu Guo and Pu Xin.

It was also because of this that they showed the strongest attitude.

Guns always liked to shoot the bird that stuck out.

In addition, some large factions, such as the Fire God Palace, the Ocean World, and the Demon Realm, had enmity with the Buddha Realm.

Therefore, on that day, nearly 10 Holy Lords joined forces and launched a terrifying attack on the Buddha Realm.

Half of the Buddha Realm was destroyed, the Bodhi Heart was dead, and the Bodhi Fruit fled in panic.

The power that the Buddha Realm had just re-established over a hundred years ago was destroyed again.

The other forces seized the time to divide it up.

It was this action that caused Subhuti to fly into a rage from the distant 49th Heavenly Layer.

"If that's the case, there's no need for the world to exist!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Subhuti waved his hand.

A giant golden lotus that blotted out the sky slowly descended.

"Rumble!"

Wherever it passed, space collapsed and planets shattered.

Soon, shocked cries came from the void.

"The World-Destroying Golden Lotus?"

"Subhuti, have you gone mad?"

"Stop!"

Subhuti laughed coldly. No! I'm doing this for the good of this world. The world has completely decayed, and it's time for it to be reborn."

"Subhuti, aren't you afraid that you'll be bound by karma by doing this? That's countless living beings and universes!" A furious roar came from the void.

"As the saying goes, if I don't enter hell, who will? Amitabha."

Then, several tall figures appeared on the 49th Heaven. Just as they were about to approach…

"Buzz!"

An enormous golden barrier spread out with Subhuti at the center, blocking out all of them.

Then, Subhuti pressed his palms together and said," Amitabha. I'm going to transcend my karma. Please don't disturb me.""

Then, mysterious runes spread out around the golden light barrier, making it impossible for the figures to see the situation inside the golden barrier.

The faces of the figures changed. In the end, they let out a muffled groan and scattered in all directions.

....

It was at this moment that Lin Fan, who was in the midst of his cultivation, suddenly heard a crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! The appearance of the World-Destroying Golden Lotus has been detected. 1. Absorb the World-Destroying Golden Lotus. You will obtain the power of destruction, 10 Saint King Crystals, and 5 Great Dao fragments. 2. If you don't care, you will receive 10 Saint King Crystals and 5 Great Dao Fragments.]

Lin Fan was stunned.

"The World-Destroying Golden Lotus?" What's that?"

[World-Destroying Golden Lotus: A terrifying magic treasure that can destroy all universes and restart them.]

When Lin Fan heard that, his pupils constricted,""Then wouldn't our Earth be destroyed as well?"

[Requires 10 billion spirit stones. Do you want to ask?]

"Inquire!" Lin Fan said hurriedly.

[Other than the Coiling Dragon Villa, Earth will suffer serious damage.]

Serious injury?

What else could he say? He had to stop it!

Lin Fan said," How should I stop it?""

[You can absorb it when you approach the World-Destroying Golden Lotus.]

That simple?

Lin Fan was stunned.

"Will my life be in danger?"

[No.]

Since that was the case, was there still a need to consider?

Lin Fan asked," Where is the World Destroying Golden Lotus?"

[You need to find it yourself.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he pondered for a moment before turning his attention to Ma Zheng.

Then, he used Soul Communication on Ma Zheng.

P.S. Welcome to my final book, Super Red Envelope Immortals.
